analysis_unit: five-fold candidate mean within each seed offset

selection_assessment.reason: No candidate has a clear pre-specified mean-FPR win; provisional choice comes from seed stability, worst seed, mean FPR, then PR-AUC.
selection_assessment.clear_win_rule: absolute mean-seed FPR advantage >= equivalence margin and at least 4 of 5 paired seed wins against each challenger

selection_note: Review seed-level stability and paired wins before locking a candidate. Do not treat the 75 fits as independent samples.
next_step: After candidate review, lock one configuration and a unified tree-count rule, regenerate comparable fixed-tree OOF scores, and select one pooled OOF threshold before using the test set.
